root.label: Hypoglossal nerve stimulation for moderate to severe OSA is medically reasonable and necessary
root.source_quote: hypoglossal nerve neurostimulation is considered medically reasonable and necessary for the treatment of moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea when all of the following criteria are met

children.label: Beneficiary is 22 years of age or older
Body mass index under 35 kg/m2
children.source_quote: Body mass index (BMI) is less than 35

children.label: Polysomnography within 24 months of the first HGNS consultation
children.source_quote: A polysomnography (PSG) is performed within 24 months of first consultation for HGNS implant

children.label: Predominantly obstructive events: central + mixed apneas under 25% of AHI
children.source_quote: predominantly obstructive events (defined as central and mixed apneas less than 25% of the total AHI)

children.label: AHI 15 to 65 events per hour
children.source_quote: AHI is 15 to 65 events per hour

children.label: Documented CPAP failure (AHI > 15 on CPAP) or intolerance (< 4 h/night, 5 nights/wk, or returned), with shared decision making
children.source_quote: documentation that demonstrates CPAP failure (defined as AHI greater than 15 despite CPAP usage) or CPAP intolerance (defined as less than 4 hours per night, 5 nights per week or the CPAP has been returned) including shared decision making that the patient was intolerant of CPAP despite consultation with a sleep expert

children.label: No complete concentric collapse at the soft palate on drug-induced sleep endoscopy
children.source_quote: Absence of complete concentric collapse at the soft palate level as seen on a drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) procedure

children.label: No anatomical findings that would compromise the device (e.g. tonsil size 3 or 4)
children.source_quote: No other anatomical findings that would compromise performance of device (e.g., tonsil size 3 or 4 per standardized tonsillar hypertrophy grading scale)

children.label: No contraindication (neuromuscular disease, hypoglossal palsy, severe pulmonary or cardiac disease, NYHA III/IV, recent MI, pregnancy, MRI need, cannot operate remote)
children.source_quote: when any of the following contraindications are present

excluded.reason: Device attribute on the order, not chart evidence.

excluded.quote: the inserting provider shall be certified
excluded.reason: Provider credentialing, not patient chart evidence.

excluded.quote: must be performed by a qualified physician (MD or DO)

excluded.reason: Defines shared decision making; checked inside the cpap leaf.
